house-floor.prompt: A puncheon floor for a log pen - split logs hewn flat on one face and laid side by side - as an overlay registered to Astra's pen (her full walls' box, anchor and scale), laid with her own hewn-log faces; drawn before the walls it shows through the doorway and over the low courses. Transparent ground, no shadow.
house-floor.rasterised: Playwright/Chrome screenshot of the inlined SVG, transparent ground (scripts/build-claude-standins.mjs)

house-loft.prompt: A pen's loft as an overlay registered to Astra's pen: joists across at the tops of the walls, a floor of boards over the back half (her planks), and a pole ladder up from the floor, for a cutaway; corner-on three-quarter view, her scale, outlined in her ink. Transparent ground, no shadow.
house-loft.rasterised: Playwright/Chrome screenshot of the inlined SVG, transparent ground (scripts/build-claude-standins.mjs)

window-lit-adobe-flat.request: Request 2026-09-25 — the south's fights: San Patricio by night and Agua Dulce Creek
window-lit-adobe-flat.prompt: Lamplight in the window of Astra's adobe-flat at night: an overlay in her frame's own box, anchor and logical height, clear except the window, filled with a warm lamp glow (pale yellow at the middle to orange at the edges) with a soft halo and her dark mullions across it; laid over her house after the night's darkness so the window shines. San Patricio, February 1836: local men left lanterns burning in their own windows (FIC-GONZ-435). Transparent elsewhere.
window-lit-adobe-flat.rasterised: Playwright/Chrome screenshot of the inlined SVG, transparent ground (scripts/build-claude-standins.mjs)
